title: Make the robot visible
prompt: The robot starts hidden. Godot already has a function that shows it: `show`. In `solve`, call it once, with nothing inside the brackets.
hints: You use someone else's function by writing its name followed by brackets.
`show()` on its own line inside solve.

docs.name: show() / hide()
docs.what: Makes the robot visible or invisible. No arguments; returns nothing.
